goals.description: Publish episodes on a consistent weekly schedule
goals.target: 1 episode per week, same day and time

goals.description: Meet broadcast-quality audio standards on every episode
goals.target: -16 LUFS, noise floor below -60dB, no clipping

goals.description: Maintain a pipeline of 5+ confirmed upcoming guests
goals.target: 5 guests confirmed at least 2 weeks ahead

goals.description: Distribute to all major platforms within 1 hour of release
goals.target: Apple Podcasts, Spotify, YouTube, RSS — simultaneous

goals.description: Extract and publish 3 social clips per episode
goals.target: 3 clips under 60 seconds, posted within 24 hours of episode
